proposal.summary: Controller 6000 is vulnerable to a buffer overflow via the Controller diagnostic web interface upload feature.
proposal.affected_product: Controller 6000: before vCR8.80.230201a, before vCR8.70.230201a, before vCR8.60.230201b, before vCR8.50.230201a, all versions of vCR8.40 and prior
proposal.cwe_quote: Controller 6000 is vulnerable to a buffer overflow via the Controller diagnostic web interface upload feature.

AV.quote: via the Controller diagnostic web interface upload feature.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request reproduction steps and a proof-of-concept from the reporter that shows whether authentication is required and whether exploitation leads to crash or code execution; coordinate with the vendor to patch or mitigate the vulnerable upload handling.

evidence_quotes.claim: Description of the vulnerability and vulnerable functionality
evidence_quotes.quote: Controller 6000 is vulnerable to a buffer overflow via the Controller diagnostic web interface upload feature.
This issue affects Controller 6000: before vCR8.80.230201a, before vCR8.70.230201a, before vCR8.60.230201b, before vCR8.50.230201a, all versions of vCR8.40 and prior.
